content: गयः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the people living round Gayā and the district inhabited by them. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of an Asura. .²3 Wealth. .²4 House, household, family. .²5 Offspring, progeny. .²6 The sky. .²7 Oneʼs own place or abode. .{@-या@} <ab>N.</ab> of a city in Behār which is a place of pilgrimage.
